## Result and scope

**30001182 / OWR-3392-009: claimed_solved, 1/5 substantive author turns.** Independent adversarial mathematical review: **PASS, no blocking defect**.

The distinct proper coordinate subalgebras B,C of C({0,1}²), with scalar intersection and the fair perfectly correlated state, have no extremal-exchangeable independence witness. After a state-preserving diagonal embedding into M₄, a pure vector-state extension supplies a pure, exchangeable witness by folding. The GNS proof excludes every downstairs candidate; the upstairs construction matches the entire B*C joint law.

Extremality here is among **all exchangeable states**, as in the printed definition. The witness also has the prescribed full marginal. Extremality in a fixed-marginal slice, faithful-only and tracial-only variants, and a specified normal W*-free-product formulation are excluded. A separate polynomial/Laurent-polynomial example verifies non-lifting in the unrestricted algebraic category; it is not a C*-state-extension counterexample.

## Sources and review

Liebscher’s complete primary contribution, OWR 09/2009 pp. 540–541, was inspected by the author and independently by the reviewer. The established pure-folding mechanism is credited to Dykema–Köstler–Williams. No historical novelty, formal-certification or human-peer-review claim is made.

All eight frozen author files and four audit files are preserved byte-for-byte. Author manifest SHA-256: b021e926e34ae33bfb761b158d69d18355eddaad87331e2585d0e4977b971a90. Audit manifest SHA-256: fe874913587ff269596044622effdec6425d6377f8eb3f4766033e7624611a19.

The exact verifier and independent replay agree on **14,944 rational controls**. The package verifier checks both manifests and reproduces those bytes. Finite controls supplement the universal proof.

## Diff and provenance

This single commit is based on fresh main 1135765a7fe02d6c2bbeca7bc1a3a4a5259650a9. The diff contains only the target attempt directory and its QUEUE.md row. Only Status, Turns, and previously blank Findings change; all other queue bytes and repository paths are preserved.

DISPOSITION.md records a provenance-only correction: the old queue header’s embedded SHA is not the actual GitHub blob identity. Actual base blob 59dba610d333684751e889818d21f66aba29cec9 and new blob 51ae6850e1dedc7639fff8fb8f8d414419db12f5 were verified against exact bytes. The original freeze remains intact. References there to a pending review describe the pre-review checkpoint, now superseded by the included PASS audit.

All 14 target files and the full queue were read back byte-exactly at head 135911efff1ad14314f0506b0d5f158ba986426f. Source PDFs, renders, extracted papers, datasets and private context are excluded.

Start with [DISPOSITION.md](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/research/30001182-ambient-exchangeable-independence/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001182/DISPOSITION.md). Run `python3 verify_package.py` from that attempt directory. This is one draft PR for this problem; no merge or release is requested.
